name: Microsoft Quincy
notes: Microsoft says it built its first datacenter in Quincy in 2008 and now has more than twenty datacenters there, with a city water-reuse plant for cooling. A June 2026 compilation reports 600 MW of power capacity for the campus; other 2026 roundups put the same campus near 500 MW, so the figure is a campus total rather than one building. The pin is the city of Quincy and is approximate.

name: AWS Attalia
notes: DatacenterDynamics reported on November 5, 2026 that county documents name AWS as the developer of the Attalia campus at the Port of Walla Walla: three 220,000-square-foot buildings on 134 acres with 300 MW. That is a scale-back of an earlier 16-building concept. The county had not made a final land-use decision, and the pin is the town of Attalia.

sources.title: AWS proceeds with data center project in Walla Walla, DatacenterDynamics

name: Vantage Santa Clara I
notes: SignalData's November 2026 Santa Clara County roundup says Vantage's own page lists six buildings on 21 acres with 77 MW of critical load and three 50 MW substations from Silicon Valley Power. The pin is 2820 Northwestern Parkway, a building associated with this campus.

name: Vantage Santa Clara III
notes: SignalData says Vantage lists this campus at 64 MW, supplied by Silicon Valley Power, and operating as of October 2024. The pin is offset about a kilometer from Vantage Santa Clara I because no street address was published in that roundup.

name: STACK SVY01 San Jose
notes: SignalData says STACK lists four buildings on 19 acres and 100 MW for SVY01. As of the November 2026 roundup, two buildings were described as operating and two still under construction. The pin is 1849 Fortune Drive, given for building SVY01C.

name: Microsoft Alviso
notes: SignalData cites a June 12, 2026 DatacenterDynamics report that Microsoft had broken ground on a 99 MW San Jose data center in Alviso, with completion slated for 2028. The pin is the Alviso neighborhood and is approximate.

name: Microsoft Orchard Parkway
notes: SignalData says the California Energy Commission page and the City of San Jose list still showed a 97.8 MW Microsoft project on Orchard Parkway under review in October 2026. It is separate from the Alviso building already under construction. The pin is Orchard Parkway and is approximate.

name: Prologis San Jose wastewater campus
notes: SignalData cites KQED (September 14, 2026) putting a Prologis proposal on San Jose-Santa Clara Regional Wastewater Facility land at 496 MW, and earlier reporting of about 1.7 million square feet of data center space in four buildings. The city council had approved an exclusive negotiating agreement, not a building permit. The pin is the wastewater facility.

name: Prologis Silver Creek
notes: SignalData cites a July 9, 2026 DatacenterDynamics report of a Prologis plan for a 99 MW, 516,000-square-foot data center at Silver Creek, plus a special-use permit (SP26-016) and a California Energy Commission filing for 44 diesel backup generators. The pin is the Silver Creek neighborhood and is approximate.

name: Menlo Equities Charlotte Drive
notes: SignalData cites an August 7, 2026 Bay Area News Group report of a Menlo Equities plan for about 444,400 square feet and 99.7 MW at Charlotte Drive, with public open space at Charlotte and Lexington. The pin is Charlotte Drive and is approximate.

name: NorthTown San Jose
notes: SignalData cites a November 2025 Baxtel report that Goodman planned two buildings totaling 414,000 square feet and up to 97.3 MW by 2028, and a July 21, 2026 notice that the California Energy Commission will prepare an environmental impact report for 42 diesel backup generators (25-SPPE-02). No street address was in that roundup, so the pin is central north San Jose and is approximate.
